name: Martini API
description:
Authenticate every request with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (the `Key <key>` form is accepted too).
Keys are created under Settings → Martini API and are server-side secrets.
Optionally pin the envelope with `X-Martini-API-Version`; the served version is echoed on every response.

Generations and runs are asynchronous: submit, then poll the status route until the status is terminal
(`completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`). There are no webhooks. Retry only 429 (after `Retry-After`) and 5xx.

Pass an `idempotencyKey` on anything you might retry: the same key returns the same object instead of charging twice.

Prices are in olives (Martini credits). Every non-2xx answer is `{ "error": <copy>, "code": <STABLE_CODE> }`;
branch on `code`. Human-readable documentation: https://www.martini.film/docs/api and https://www.martini.film/docs/workflows.
